headword: データ{入力|にゅうりょく}

definitions.explanation: The process of entering data into a computer system, database, or spreadsheet. Also refers to the job or task of typing information into digital systems, a common type of office and part-time work.

examples.japanese: データ{入力|にゅうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a data entry job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧データ{入力|にゅうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: I have to do a large amount of data entry every day.

examples.japanese: データ{入力|にゅうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦ダブル→ダブル：24220_daburu⟧⟦チェック→チェック：03000_chekku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}えた→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
examples.english: To prevent data entry errors, we established a double-checking system.

notes:
Composed of ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧ (data, from English) and ⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}→入力：04769_nyuuryoku⟧ (input; entry). A standard term in office and IT environments. Data entry work (データ{入力|にゅうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧) is a common part-time and remote job category in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- データ{入力|にゅうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: data entry work/job
- データ{入力|にゅうりょく}ミス: data entry error
- データ{入力|にゅうりょく}{作業|さぎょう}: data entry task/operation
- データ{入力|にゅうりょく}{画面|がめん}: data entry screen

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入力|にゅうりょく}→入力：04769_nyuuryoku⟧: input — the general act of entering information into a system
- ⟦{打|う}ち{込|こ}み→打ち込む：04229_uchikomu⟧: typing in; keying in — emphasizes the physical act of typing
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: data processing — broader term covering manipulation and analysis of data, not just entry
